line: Lenovo Legion 5 15 Gen 10 (2025, 15.1" OLED, Arrow Lake-HX refresh)
config_name: Legion 5 15.1 Gen 10 — Core Ultra 9 275HX / RTX 5070 8GB (115W), 16GB DDR5, 1TB SSD, 15.1" WQXGA OLED 165Hz

specs.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Laptop 8GB GDDR7 (115 W TGP incl. Dynamic Boost, MUX)
specs.ports: 2x USB-C 3.2 Gen2 (DP, PD 3.0), 3x USB-A 3.2, HDMI 2.1, RJ45 GbE, 3.5mm

battery.notes: 80 Wh. NBC AMD anchor 9.5h WiFi; HX-class Intel parts 'noticeably shorter' — Arrow Lake-HX slightly more efficient than Raptor Lake-HX, est. ~7h WiFi.

offers.name: Lenovo Legion 5 15.1" WQXGA OLED 165Hz Gaming Laptop - Intel Ultra 9 275HX - 16GB DDR5 - 1TB SSD - RTX 5070 8GB - Windows 11 - Black

reviews.quote: Its gaming performance is on par with the more expensive Legion 5 Pro 16. Combined with an excellent OLED display boasting a 165 Hz refresh rate and impressive brightness, gaming becomes an absolute pleasure.

professional.note: NBC reviewed the same 15.1" OLED chassis with RTX 5070 (87%); this tier swaps in the Arrow Lake-HX Ultra 9 275HX. RTINGS/Tom's: no numeric score found, not cited.

praises: Same superb 15.1" OLED (495 nits SDR / 1067 nits HDR measured, 0.9 deltaE, 165 Hz) that NBC scored 'excellent' at the mainstream price
Ultra 9 275HX 24-core Arrow Lake-HX is the fastest CPU option in the line — strong for compile/render multitasking
RTX 5070 at full 115 W with MUX switch — 'on par with the more expensive Legion 5 Pro 16' (NBC)
Easy upgrades: 2x SODIMM to 64GB, dual M.2, screwed battery, replaceable Wi-Fi module, official maintenance manual
Light 1.94 kg OLED chassis (lighter than the IPS version), comfortable keyboard + numpad, Wi-Fi 7
complaints: 16GB RAM on a $3,649 sale / $5,229 regular config — upgrade to 32GB is the obvious first move (NBC tested 32GB)
HX-class power draw costs battery vs the AMD Ryzen option (NBC: Intel model has 'noticeably shorter battery life')
Fans clearly audible at 50.1 dB(A) in Performance-mode gaming (NBC)
No card reader; USB-C tops out at 10 Gbps Gen2 on Intel models (no USB4) per NBC
Glossy-only OLED + PWM flicker (NBC cons); Legion Gen-10 owner threads report warranty friction and occasional fan/OLED quirks

design_philosophy: The Legion 5 Gen 10 line gives mainstream buyers flagship-panel OLED and full-TGP Blackwell graphics without premium-chassis markup; this Arrow Lake-HX tier is the CPU-top option of that formula — the 24-core Ultra 9 paired with the line's OLED + RTX 5070 core, at the cost of RAM (16GB) to hold price.
rating_notes: Ratings inferred from NBC-reviewed 15.1" OLED RTX 5070 configs (87%) per SHARED-legion5-oled.md: 275HX Arrow Lake-HX gets +0.2 productivity vs i9-14900HX tier and +0.5 battery (Arrow Lake-HX more efficient than Raptor Lake-HX), −0.5 productivity / −0.3 ai_ml for 16GB vs tested 32GB.
